map.输入纬度、年中第几日、日照时数，按 Angstrom-Prescott 公式估算: Enter the latitude, the day of the year and the sunshine hours to estimate the extraterrestrial radiation, the solar radiation reaching the surface and the photovoltaic power potential via the Angstrom-Prescott formula.
map.📖 查看「日照辐射计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Solar Radiation Calculation User Guide"
map.💡 公式：Ra = 37.6·dr·(ωs·sinφ·sinδ + cosφ·c: 💡 Formula: Ra = 37.6·dr·(ωs·sinφ·sinδ + cosφ·cosδ·sinωs); Rs = Ra·(0.25+0.5·n/N); daily generation = (Rs/3.6)·capacity·efficiency. δ is the solar declination, ωs the sunset hour angle and N the daylight duration.
map.采用 FAO Angstrom-Prescott 经验公式，经验系数 a=0.2: Uses the FAO Angstrom-Prescott empirical formula with coefficients a=0.25, b=0.5 (common values for temperate zones)
map.高纬度极昼极夜区域计算结果可能异常，仅供参考: Results may be anomalous in polar-day/polar-night regions at high latitudes and are for reference only
map.系统效率综合了逆变器、线损、温度、灰尘等损失，一般取 0.75-0.85: System efficiency combines inverter, line, temperature and dust losses, typically 0.75-0.85
map.📚 深度解析：降水与蒸发平衡计算: 📚 In-depth: Precipitation and Evaporation Balance Calculation
map.与蒸发量算区域水分盈亏。: and evaporation, compute the regional water balance.
map.农业灌溉定额 = 蒸散 − 有效降水。: Agricultural irrigation quota = evapotranspiration − effective precipitation.
map.干旱预警看盈亏持续为负。: Drought warning looks at a persistently negative balance.
map.月降水 40 mm、潜在蒸散 80 mm → 盈亏=40−80=−40 mm（亏: Monthly precipitation 40 mm, potential evapotranspiration 80 mm → balance = 40−80 = −40 mm (deficit); about 40 mm of supplemental irrigation is needed to balance crop water demand.
map.连续 3 月各亏 30 mm，累计 −90 mm，土壤墒情下降，触发轻旱预警。: Three consecutive months each with a 30 mm deficit, cumulating −90 mm, lowers soil moisture and triggers a mild drought warning.
map.蒸散和蒸发一样吗？: Is evapotranspiration the same as evaporation?
map.蒸散 ET=土壤蒸发+植被蒸腾，比单纯水面蒸发更贴近农田耗水。: Evapotranspiration ET = soil evaporation + vegetation transpiration, closer to farmland water consumption than plain water-surface evaporation.
map.盈亏为负就要灌？: Does a negative balance mean irrigate?
map.看作物耐旱与根层蓄水，短期负值可靠土壤水补，长期负值才需灌溉。: It depends on crop drought tolerance and root-zone storage; short-term negative values can be covered by soil water, and only long-term negative values require irrigation.
map.基于 FAO 推荐的 Angstrom-Prescott 公式，由纬度、日期计算: Based on the FAO-recommended Angstrom-Prescott formula, it computes the solar declination and sunset hour angle from latitude and date, then estimates the extraterrestrial radiation, daylight duration and total solar radiation reaching the surface, converting them into peak sun hours and photovoltaic power potential.
